event.title: Resignations at Reform UK Amid Allegations of Foreign Funding Scandal
event.canonical_title: Resignations at Reform UK Amid Allegations of Foreign Funding Scandal
event.summary: Two senior aides to Nigel Farage have stepped down from Reform UK following allegations that the party arranged for a foreign company to fund political polling. This comes after an undercover investigation suggested the party may have violated UK electoral laws regarding foreign donations.

timeline.title: Resignations at Reform UK Amid Allegations of Foreign Funding Scandal
timeline.summary: Two senior officials from the Reform UK party stepped down following an undercover investigation that allegedly revealed discussions about soliciting foreign funding for party activities, which is illegal under UK law. The investigation suggested a potential £500,000 donation from a US donor. Reform UK has denied any wrongdoing, claiming it was a victim of a hoax.
key_facts: Two senior officials from Reform UK stepped down.
An undercover investigation suggested soliciting foreign funding.
A potential £500,000 donation from a US donor was mentioned.
Foreign funding is prohibited under UK law.
Reform UK denies wrongdoing and claims it was a victim of a hoax.
